metadata.description:
These are the input and output streams of my AlphaFold agents. 
    The goal for this workflow is to view all the different levels of protein complexity in 
    order for research scientist to have a better estimation  of disordered regions of proteins.

agents.name: amnio acid agent
agents.description:
Retrives a codon sequence from SCOP database and match it amnio acids
      to build a protein primary structure - polypeptide.

agents.name: chemical structure agent
agents.description: Visualize chemical structures that are key to a protein folding

agents.name: Functional Domain Visualizer
agents.description: Show a close up view of a protein domain while showing its function and identity
